entities.name: John J. Snyder
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Joseph Snyder was an American prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as the eighth bishop of the Diocese of St. Augustine in Florida from 1979 to 2000. Snyder previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Brooklyn in New York from 1972 to 1979
